meta.title: Viewing Spots — Whizzzest
meta.description: Where to watch fireworks in Wanzai, Jiangxi. Find viewing areas and travel tips for Wanzai Ancient City and Longhu Park.

hero.title: Fireworks viewing spots
hero.subtitle: Where to watch in Wanzai Ancient City and Longhu Park

spots.name: Wanzai Ancient City
spots.desc: Fireworks light up the tiled roofs and stepped gables of Wanzai Ancient City. The regular outdoor show is usually at 8 pm on Saturdays. Check the latest venue announcement before making plans.
spots.viewing: Lüyin Square, the riverside promenade and the ancient city viewing terrace
spots.transport: In the heart of Wanzai's county seat — reachable by bus or taxi

spots.name: Longhu Park
spots.desc: Longhu Park has open views across the lake, where fireworks are reflected in the water. Check the event notice for dates, approved viewing areas and any ticket requirements.
spots.viewing: The lakeside boardwalk, the mid-lake pavilion and the lakeside lawns
spots.transport: In the southwest of the county seat — reachable by bus or taxi

tips.title: Check the schedule
items: The regular Wanzai Ancient City show is usually at 8 pm on Saturdays.
A separate schedule may apply on public holidays and during the Wanzai Fireworks Festival.
Check the venue’s latest announcement for the time and any changes.
If a display is announced for Longhu Park, confirm the park venue on the event notice.
Allow time to reach the viewing area before the display begins.

tips.title: Good to know
items: Arrive early and use designated public viewing areas.
Keep clear of launch sites and restricted areas.
Bring a camera or phone to capture the moment

faq.q: When is the Wanzai Ancient City fireworks show?
faq.a: The regular show is usually at 8 pm on Saturdays. For holiday programs, delays or cancellations, check the latest venue announcement.

faq.q: Where are the best places to watch?
faq.a: Wanzai Ancient City (Lüyin Square, the riverside promenade and the ancient city viewing terrace) and Longhu Park (the lakeside boardwalk, the mid-lake pavilion and the lakeside lawns).
The regular Wanzai Ancient City show is generally free to watch. Separately ticketed events may have different arrangements.

faq.q: How do I get to the Ancient City and Longhu Park?
faq.a: Both venues are in Wanzai’s county seat. You can use a local bus or taxi. Check for temporary traffic restrictions on show days.
